paragraphs.zh: 其中，路线(v)表示由式(IV)化合物制备式(V)的羧酸化合物，路线(v′)表示由式(IV)化合物直接制备式(VIII)的酯化合物。
paragraphs.en: Wherein, route (v) represents the preparation of the carboxylic acid compound of formula (V) from the compound of formula (IV), and route (v') represents the direct preparation of the ester compound of formula (VIII) from the compound of formula (IV).

paragraphs.zh: 在更具体的实施方式中，所述步骤(v)和(v′)分别为以下步骤，这些步骤的更具体实施方式如前文所述。
paragraphs.en: In more specific embodiments, said steps (v) and (v') are respectively the following steps; more specific embodiments of these steps are as described above.

paragraphs.zh: 本发明制备环磺酮的新方法可以进一步包括如下(i)～(iv)中任意一个或两个以上的中间体制备步骤：
paragraphs.en: The novel process of the present invention for preparing tembotrione may further comprise any one or two or more of the following intermediate preparation steps (i) to (iv):
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name of the herbicide; translated here as tembotrione, which is what the name denotes literally (cyclo-sulfonyl-trione).
